HOW TO OPEN
Double-click index.html in this folder. Keep the assets folder beside it.
No installation, account, or internet connection is needed.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Click Decouvrir la surprise, then Commencer nos souvenirs.
2. Answer each question, then use the arrow keys or on-screen arrows to move right toward the chest.
3. Read each memory and click Continuer la mission.
4. After five levels, enter the five collected letters and click the chest to open it.
5. The ERREUR 404 screen is part of the surprise. Click Lancer la correction.
6. Open the envelope, view the diploma, and discover the final gift message.

NOTES
Recommencer starts the game again.
The letter can be edited; Voir le diplome officiel saves it on this browser/device only.
The sound button currently changes its label but the game has no audio implemented.
This folder is a local website. Sending a localhost address will not let someone else open it.
To share offline, send this whole folder as a ZIP and have the recipient extract it first.
